name: Bill Kristol
role: American political commentator; former Republican strategist, Weekly Standard cofounder and Bulwark editor
summary: Kristol advocates American military leadership and democratic intervention abroad, while defending constitutional checks against Trump at home. His later arguments defend health assistance and individual liberties more than his earlier Republican campaigns; several social-policy boundaries remain unclear.
